thread.title: Point and click adventure game Detective Gallo lands on iOS!

title: Point and click adventure game Detective Gallo lands on iOS!
text:
Point and click adventure game Detective Gallo lands on iOS! Posted: 7 hours, 56 mins ago | Apps Press Releases | Stock Ticker: TYO:7974, NASDAQ:AAPL
Turin, 23/01/2019 - Oh yes we really love point and click adventure games: Detective Gallo will be available on iOS devices (iPhone and iPad) on January 24!
Detective Gallo is a point&click comic-noir adventure that is entirely hand-illustrated and hand-animated, and whose protagonist is a feathered and grumpy private eye struggling with a very tricky case, bizarre characters, and puzzles that will put his insight and patience to the test.
An adventure inspired by classic cartoons and the best point&click adventure games of the past!
Play as Gallo, a... rooster noir detective, and investigate on a multiple plant murder!
Meet lots of incredible characters, all hand-animated, frame-by-frame.
Dozens and dozens of logical puzzles and quests!
Listen to over 50 minutes of original pure jazz-noir soundtrack!
Fully translated in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish and Russian
Fully dubbed in English and Italian
